_README: This is the ONE place to change business details. Edit, save, then run `node build.js` (Cloudflare does this automatically on every push). Never put API keys or passwords in this file: it is public.

whatsapp._note: Digits only, country code first, no + or spaces. Change this if you get a separate WhatsApp Business number.

email._note: Only the public address is shown on the website. The owner address is kept here for reference and for future back-end notifications.

registeredOffice.notice: Registered office — not a customer service location.

areas._pagesNote: Areas that have their own local page. Their chips on the homepage and Areas page link to it. A new local page also needs a file in src/pages/.

availability.emergencyText: Emergency call-outs available — call to confirm current availability.
availability.generalText: Call, WhatsApp or email and we will confirm availability for your job.

hours._note: Leave confirmed=false until you have decided your hours. When confirmed, set displayText (e.g. 'Monday to Friday 8am–6pm, Saturday 9am–1pm') and fill openingHoursSpecification so search engines can read them.

_showPlaceholdersNote: true = show clearly labelled 'owner to add' boxes for credentials, reviews and the review link. Set to false before launch if you have not filled them in; empty items will then be hidden instead.

reviews.author: Khesraw B.
reviews.text:
Very much satisfied with your job
Thanks for being so honest person beside being professional

_reviewsNote: Add ONLY genuine reviews, copied word for word with permission or from your Google Business Profile. Format: { "author": "First name + initial", "text": "...", "rating": 5, "date": "2026-11-01", "source": "Google" }
_googleSiteVerificationNote: Optional. Only the content value of the HTML tag Google Search Console gives you for a URL-prefix property (the long code inside content="..."). Adds <meta name="google-site-verification"> to every page. Not needed if you verify with a DNS TXT record instead.

social._note: Official accounts only, confirmed by the owner. Empty = not shown. Facebook: paste the page's own link (facebook.com/... or facebook.com/profile.php?id=...). YouTube is pending until YouTube is enabled for the Workspace account. LinkedIn page not yet created.

logo._note: Owner's logo. icon = ABS monogram only, for small spaces. src = for light backgrounds (header). OnDark = same logo with the black lettering lightened, for the dark footer. Original file and monograms: brand/. Favicons and app icons in static/ are made from the AB monogram.

enquiryForm._note: Where the quote form and the receptionist chat send enquiries: the amiri-receptionist-api Worker, which saves them (D1), stores photos privately (R2) and emails waris@. Empty = the form opens WhatsApp or email instead, as before. If you change this host, also change connect-src in static/_headers.

aiChat._aiEndpointNote: AI answers for free-typed questions, served by the website Worker itself (worker/index.js, Cloudflare Workers AI, capped inside the free daily allowance). Questions about prices, gas, emergencies and availability always get the fixed answers. Empty = built-in answers only.
aiChat._note: AI_CHAT_ENABLED. false = no chat code or styles are loaded at all. The chat answers common questions from fixed, approved answers (no AI service, no running cost), takes the customer through a quote request and submits it to enquiryForm.endpoint (or, if that is empty, lets them send it by WhatsApp or email). aiEndpoint: optional AI answers, see its note. turnstileSiteKey: optional Cloudflare Turnstile spam check (public site key; the secret key goes on the API Worker only). coveredPostcodeAreas: postcode districts treated as your usual area (others get 'we'll check and let you know').

analytics._note: Optional. Prefer automatic Web Analytics setup in the Cloudflare dashboard (no code needed). Only fill this if you use the manual JS snippet. Do NOT add Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or other trackers without a consent mechanism.

pricing._note: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-06. Do not add figures until prices are decided.
pricing.maybeCharged: Site visits, diagnostics and emergency call-outs may be chargeable.
pricing.explain: We will explain any charge before we start.
